subject: Revenue recognition deadlines & billing / PO timing checklist
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Melanie Torres <melanie.torres@acumenhealth.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Revenue recognition deadlines & billing / PO timing checklist

Hi Melanie —

Quick follow up from our call this morning. We want to make sure Redwood recognizes this work in the correct period and that your AP team has what they need to trigger invoicing. Two quick asks so we don't miss September cutoffs: 

1) Can you confirm the PO effective date and whether Acumen will approve invoices dated 9/30 or require 10/1 billing?
2) Any specific PO number format or procurement code we should include on the invoice to avoid delays?

I attached a draft RevTimingChecklist (v2) that maps our internal commit windows to typical customer PO cutoffs — would you mind confirming the PO and payment terms? If PO needs to be in place before we ship usage for recognition, we want to lock the stage by EOD Friday to meet revenue timelines.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0182

Attachments: RevTimingChecklist_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 18KB)
From: Melanie Torres <melanie.torres@acumenhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: PO Team <po-team@procureco.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Revenue recognition deadlines & billing / PO timing checklist

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the checklist — attaching the signed PO (Acumen_PO_20260917.pdf). Short answers: 
- PO effective date: 2026-09-17. Our AP requires invoice date on or after 9/17. Invoices dated 9/30 are acceptable; we cannot accept backdated invoices earlier than the PO effective date.
- Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice date.
- PO format: Please include the PO number (ACM-2026-0097) in the invoice header and the procurement code AC-IT-44 in the invoice line item.

We can confirm this will clear for recognition in September as long as invoice is submitted by end of day 9/30 and references the PO number and procurement code. We prefer PDF invoices uploaded to our ProcureCo portal (link below) or emailed to po-team@procureco.com with the PO number in the subject.

Melanie Torres
Finance Manager, Vendor Payments
Acumen Health

Attachments: Acumen_PO_20260917.pdf (PDF, 42KB)
Related link: https://procureco.com/upload/ACM-2026-0097
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Revenue recognition deadlines & billing / PO timing checklist

Team —

Per Melanie: PO effective 9/17, invoice by 9/30 acceptable, PO number = ACM-2026-0097, procurement code AC-IT-44. That means: 

- Billing must generate an invoice dated no later than 2026-09-30 and include the PO number and procurement code.
- Finance needs to have the final usage delta and invoice PDF in hand no later than 2026-09-30 12:00 PT to allow for upload and AP processing windows.

Rachel — can you confirm the billing run cutover time and whether we can shift the export to ensure the PDF is generated before noon PT on 9/30? If not, we need to push for an exception with Acumen (Melanie is copied in on exceptions).

Sean — please lock the commit for this opportunity in the forecast so rev ops can close the month. If you see any outstanding approval steps on the sales side, flag them immediately.

Thanks — Vanessa

Thanks Vanessa — locking now. I ran the commit checklist and confirmed there are no open contract approvals in the Deal Desk queue. I will also mark the opportunity as 100% commit for September in the forecast and add the PO number to the booking record.

Rachel — I can reach out to Billing Ops if we need a 9/30 export time tweak, but I expect we can hit the current 11:00 PT run and still get the PDF up to ProcureCo by noon. If Billing Ops pushes back, I'll escalate to Karthik for prioritization.

- Sean

Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Revenue recognition deadlines & billing / PO timing checklist — confirmed actions

Melanie / team — quick summary and action items so we have a single source of truth: 

- Acumen PO ACM-2026-0097 (effective 2026-09-17) received and on file (attached).
- Invoice date allowed: on/after 9/17; to be considered for September recognition invoice must be dated 9/30 and uploaded to ProcureCo by 2026-09-30 12:00 PT.
- Billing Ops plan: standard export at 11:00 PT on 9/30 will be used; Sean confirmed opportunity will be locked and marked as committed for September.
- Owner assignments: Vanessa (coordinate final invoice PDF and upload), Rachel (confirm final usage delta and invoice generation), Sean (forecast commit + Deal record PO update), Karthik (escalation if billing run timing needs change).

Next steps: 
1) Rachel: share final usage delta by 2026-09-30 09:00 PT.
2) Sean: confirm upload complete by 2026-09-30 12:30 PT.

Melanie — if ProcureCo prefers a different upload mechanism, please let us know today so we can adapt. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
